title: Is StyleKorean legit? The company is real; the complaints are about delivery, fees and refunds
seoTitle: Is StyleKorean legit? Rating, complaints and what to check
description: StyleKorean belongs to a company listed in Korea and rates 1.9 on Trustpilot. See what the 60 most recent reviews say and what to check before you pay for an order.
metaDescription: Reward Code CECILIA010 gives up to 5% extra at YesStyle. Is StyleKorean legit? Rating 1.9, complaints and what to check before paying.

contentSections.heading: Quick answer
paragraphs: StyleKorean is run by Silicon2, a company listed in Korea. Its 1.9 rating on Trustpilot (137 reviews) means the delivery and fee complaints deserve a close look. Go with YesStyle if you put reputation first: it rates 4.4 on Trustpilot, and CECILIA010 adds up to 5% extra.

contentSections.heading: Who is behind StyleKorean
paragraphs: StyleKorean is the online store of Silicon2, a company based in Seongnam, South Korea. The company name appears in the store's own FAQ and footer. According to the company history Silicon2 publishes, it was founded in 2002, launched the global StyleKorean site in 2015, listed on the KOSDAQ, the Korean stock exchange, in 2021, and recorded revenue of KRW 1.12 trillion (Korean won) in 2025.
That shows the company exists, not that your order will arrive. For that, see the customer reports further down.

contentSections.heading: The rating, and what it measures
paragraphs: StyleKorean rates 1.9 on Trustpilot, and 63% of its reviews are 1 star. The gap to YesStyle is large, with a caveat about the size and origin of the reviews.

comparisonTable.caption: Profiles on trustpilot.com, read in November.

postParagraphs: Trustpilot says StyleKorean has not invited customers to review recently and warns that its reviews may not be representative. YesStyle does invite customers to review. The two collect reviews differently; that fact alone does not explain the gap between the ratings.
The store answers 22% of negative reviews. The app on the US App Store rates 2.7 across 135 ratings: that is a rating of the app, not a measure of delivery.

contentSections.heading: What the 60 most recent reviews say
paragraphs: We read the 60 most recent reviews on the profile, all of them unprompted, and sorted each by its main subject. There are 12 positive and 48 negative: 44 with 1 star and 4 with 2 stars. Delivery and customs account for 26 of the 48.

comparisonTable.caption: Trustpilot reviews from March 2025 to October 2026. Our classification, one subject per review.
headers: Main subject of the 48 negative reviews
rows: Delivery stalled, late, never shipped or lost
Customs: unexpected fee or parcel held

postParagraphs: On delivery, reviewers report orders stuck in preparation and parcels that never arrive. On customs, they report unexpected charges on delivery, including in Europe and the UK, and parcels held in the US; three of them blame the hold on missing documents from the store. On cancellations, they report money that never comes back and orders shipped after they asked to cancel. Some use the word fraud when describing these cases, and we have no way to verify them.
This count describes the sample and cannot be turned into a failure rate. It shows what the complaints in the sample are about, not how many orders go wrong.

contentSections.heading: What the positive reviews praise
paragraphs: That is 12 of the 60: 11 with 5 stars and 1 with 4. The praise mentions fast delivery, good packaging and price. Two, from the UK, report tax paid at checkout with no charge on delivery, and one reports a refund after a stalled parcel. Two of the positive reviews say they paid charges on delivery.
The same store shows up with orders that arrive in a week and with orders stuck for months. The sample does not say what separates one case from the other.

contentSections.heading: What the store promises and what reviewers report
paragraphs: The second column comes from StyleKorean's shipping, returns and FAQ pages. The third comes from the reviews.

rows: Not in the price and at your expense; in the US and Canada, charged at checkout
Unexpected charge on delivery; in the UK, some report tax paid at checkout with no further charge and others report paying twice
Parcel returned or destroyed, with no money back
Up to 5 business days to the carrier; the FAQ says 72 business hours
Order stuck in preparation; some praise the speed
In store points or to the payment method; for the latter, the policy mentions 2 to 14 business days
Delayed or missing refunds on canceled and undelivered orders
Photos and receipt; refund by degree of damage, no reshipping

contentSections.heading: The store's replies
paragraphs: StyleKorean answers 22% of negative reviews, usually after more than 1 month. The profile was claimed in September. In the sample, 10 of the 60 have a reply, all from the end of that month, and they reach back to reviews from June; the most recent, from October, has no reply. Several replies ask the customer to contact support through their own account. At YesStyle, the rate is 99%, usually within 24 hours.
We don't know how many of these cases ended up resolved.

contentSections.heading: Are the products authentic?
paragraphs: StyleKorean's FAQ states that all products are authentic and come straight from the brands or from trusted suppliers in Korea. None of the 60 reviews says the buyer received a fake product.
That is as far as we can go. We found no independent audit and did not buy from the store to test it. The absence of complaints in a small sample does not guarantee that every product is authentic.

contentSections.heading: What we can't conclude
bullets: **How often an order goes wrong:** Trustpilot shows who wrote, not the total number of orders.
**Which country carries more risk:** the complaints come from the US, Canada, the UK, Italy, Germany, Spain, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, among others, in numbers too small to compare.
**Whether support improved with the replies on Trustpilot:** the profile only recently started answering.
**Whether it is more or less safe than any other store:** the only comparison here is with YesStyle.

contentSections.heading: Before you pay
paragraphs: If the product you want is only at StyleKorean, or costs much less there, check in this order:
bullets: **Check shipping and delivery time in the cart, with your address.** Free shipping varies by country.
**Work out the tax for your country.** Outside the US and Canada, it can be charged before delivery, at your expense.
**Decide beforehand whether you accept paying that charge.** Refusing the parcel over customs gets no refund and no reshipping.
**Stay within the US$500 limit per order, not counting shipping.** Above that, the store recommends placing two orders.
**Keep the order number, tracking, receipts and photos of the parcel.** For damage, the store asks for photos and the receipt.

**Mark the 14 business days to request a return, counted from receipt.** On a return at your request, shipping is deducted from the refund, even if it was free at purchase. The store does not accept returns for allergic reactions.

contentSections.heading: What about other countries?
paragraphs: The answer depends on where you live. In the US and Canada, the store says customs charges are paid at checkout. In the UK, reviewers split: some report VAT paid at checkout with no further charge, others report paying twice. Elsewhere, check the checkout: see whether it accepts your address, what the shipping costs, and whether taxes are included or may be collected later.
YesStyle's rules by country are in [our YesStyle shipping guide](/en/reviews/yesstyle-shipping-us-uk-canada-australia).

contentSections.heading: Frequently asked questions
bullets: Is StyleKorean safe, or a scam? The store is run by Silicon2, a company that is identified and listed in Korea. The reports we read are about delivery, fees and refunds, and some reviewers use the word fraud for those cases. A low rating is not proof of fraud, and nothing here guarantees that every order will be resolved.

Does StyleKorean sell authentic products? The store states that its products are authentic and come from the brands or from trusted suppliers in Korea. None of the 60 reviews we read says the buyer received a fake product. We found no independent audit, and we did not buy from the store to test it.
Where is StyleKorean from? South Korea. It is run by Silicon2, from Seongnam, and ships from Korea.
Why was I charged tax on delivery? Because, outside the US and Canada, the store does not include charges in the price and leaves them to the customer, and they can be collected before delivery.
What happens if I refuse the parcel? If the refusal is over a customs issue, such as unpaid tax, the store's policy excludes refund and reshipping.

Can I get a refund at StyleKorean? The policy provides for a refund in store points, valid for 6 months, or to the payment method. For the latter, it mentions 2 to 14 business days. Some reviewers report delayed or missing refunds.
Do you have a StyleKorean code? No. CECILIA010 is only for YesStyle and does not work at StyleKorean.

takeIf: The product you want is only there, or costs less there even with shipping and charges.
You have estimated the charges for your destination and the purchase still makes sense if there is a charge before delivery.
skipIf: The delay and refund complaints, and the way the store responds, weigh more for you than the savings.
The same product is at YesStyle, and it delivers to your address.
A surprise charge on delivery would hurt your wallet, since refusing the parcel gets no refund.
